Hyatt Regency Lucknow — F&B campaigns (2018–19).

One property, several restaurants, a single design hand — across the menu and across the calendar. “Double Drinks” for the UPS bar, “Majestic Mango” for Rocca, “Thai Town,” “An Emperor’s Feast” and “An Asiatic Affair” for Lukhin — plus the occasions a hotel lives by: Father’s Day, Halloween, and “Live it Up at UP’S” for the 2018 football World Cup.

F&B campaign design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·43.
